question.text: The plane <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> intersect <math><mi>x</mi></math>-axis, <math><mi>y</mi></math>-axis and <math><mi>z</mi></math>-axis at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>B</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math> respectively. If the distance between the origin and the centroid of <math><mo>∆</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></math> is <math><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> units and the volume of the tetrahedron <math><mi>O</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></math> is <math><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> cubic units, then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to (where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>O</mi></math> is the origin)

solution.text:
x1+y2+z3=1 cuts x -axis, y -axis, z -axis at A1,0,0,B0,2,0,C0,0,3 respectively
Centroid of ∆ABC is 13,23,1
Distance between centroid and origin is k1=19+49+1
⇒k1=143 units
Volume of tetrahedron OABC=16×OA×OB×OC
k2=16×1×2×3=1 cubic unit
k12k2=1491=149
